name: Translarr
description: Translarr translates subtitle tracks from the wrong language into your preferred language using AI. It plugs into Sonarr, Radarr, Emby, Jellyfin, and Plex via webhooks and drops translated `.srt` files next to your media. When a release lands with Russian fansubs on a Japanese anime, or hardcoded Spanish on a Korean drama, Translarr extracts the track, translates it with a context-aware LLM, adjusts timing for the target language's reading rate, and writes a clean `.srt` next to the video. Features: - LLM-powered translation with context awareness (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, or local Ollama) - Automatic reading-rate adaptation so subtitles stay readable - Tag-based opt-in via Sonarr/Radarr: only translates what you tag - On-demand translation when you press Play in Emby - 6 translation presets: Quick & Cheap, Balanced, Best Quality, Local & Free, DeepSeek Budget, Gemini Flash - Cost guards: daily and per-job spend caps - Push notifications via ntfy.sh - Web UI: dashboard, job history, settings, library browser, glossary editor - All settings are live-mutable, no container restart needed

paths.name: Media Library
paths.description: Path to your media library (movies, TV shows). Translarr writes translated .srt files next to source videos.

paths.name: Config / Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for database and settings. Include this in backups.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port to map to container port 9000 (Web UI and API).

variables.name: LLM Provider
variables.description: anthropic, openai, ollama, deepseek, or gemini

variables.name: Anthropic API Key
variables.description: Required when LLM Provider is anthropic. Get one at console.anthropic.com.

variables.name: Target Language
variables.description: ISO 639-1 code for target language (en, de, es, fr, ja, etc.).

variables.name: Daily Cost Cap (cents)
variables.description: Hard kill-switch in cents (1000 = $10). Translations stop until midnight UTC.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Required when LLM Provider is openai.

variables.name: DeepSeek API Key
variables.description: Required when LLM Provider is deepseek. Approximately $0.10 per episode.

variables.name: Gemini API Key
variables.description: Required when LLM Provider is gemini. Flash tier is approximately $0.08 per episode.

variables.name: Per-Job Cost Cap (cents)
variables.description: Max spend per single translation in cents (500 = $5).

variables.name: Max Concurrent Jobs
variables.description: How many translations may run in parallel.

variables.name: Webhook Secret
variables.description: Shared secret for arr webhook auth. Empty = no auth (fine on a private LAN).

variables.name: Emby URL
variables.description: Emby server URL for library refresh hooks (e.g. http://emby:8096).

variables.name: Emby API Key
variables.description: Emby API key for library refresh and the in-player subtitle picker.

variables.name: Jellyfin URL
variables.description: Jellyfin server URL for library refresh hooks.

variables.name: Jellyfin API Key
variables.description: Jellyfin API key for library refresh.

variables.name: ntfy URL
variables.description: ntfy.sh push endpoint for job notifications. Empty = off.

variables.name: Ollama Host
variables.description: Ollama server URL (for the free local provider).
